001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.hullmods;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BaseHullMod;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableShipStatsAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI.HullSize;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
008
009@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
010public class DamagedWeaponMounts extends BaseHullMod {
011
012        public static float ROTATE_MULT = 0.75f;
013        public static float RECOIL_PERCENT = 30f;
014        public static float HEALTH_PERCENT = 25f;
015        
016        public void applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(HullSize hullSize, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
017                float effect = stats.getDynamic().getValue(Stats.DMOD_EFFECT_MULT);
018                float rotMult = ROTATE_MULT + (1f - ROTATE_MULT) * (1f - effect);
019                
020                stats.getWeaponTurnRateBonus().modifyMult(id, rotMult);
021                stats.getBeamWeaponTurnRateBonus().modifyMult(id, rotMult);
022                stats.getMaxRecoilMult().modifyPercent(id, RECOIL_PERCENT * effect);
023                stats.getRecoilPerShotMult().modifyPercent(id, RECOIL_PERCENT * effect);
024                
025                stats.getWeaponHealthBonus().modifyPercent(id, -HEALTH_PERCENT);
026                
027//              stats.getBallisticAmmoBonus().modifyPercent(id, AMMO_BONUS);
028//              stats.getEnergyAmmoBonus().modifyPercent(id, AMMO_BONUS);
029                
030                CompromisedStructure.modifyCost(hullSize, stats, id);
031        }
032        
033        public String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship) {
034                float effect = 1f;
035                if (ship != null) effect = ship.getMutableStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.DMOD_EFFECT_MULT);
036                
037                float rotMult = ROTATE_MULT + (1f - ROTATE_MULT) * (1f - effect);
038                
039                if (index == 0) return "" + (int)Math.round((1f - rotMult) * 100f) + "%";
040                if (index == 1) return "" + (int) Math.round(RECOIL_PERCENT * effect) + "%";
041                if (index == 2) return "" + (int) Math.round(HEALTH_PERCENT * effect) + "%";
042                if (index >= 3) return CompromisedStructure.getCostDescParam(index, 3);
043                return null;
044        }
045}
